label: base
desc: Check frame time at the Kokiri spawn and on the walk with default settings

label: split-0
desc: Check frame time without the GPU thread split (EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=0; practice default 2)

label: split-1
desc: Check frame time with GPU thread split mode 1 instead of 2

label: fence-batch-0
desc: Check frame time without batched GPU fence syncpoints (EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=0)

label: mme-jit-0
desc: Check frame time with the GPU macro JIT off (EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=0)

label: nx2-no-reactive
desc: Check frame time with Switch 2 reactive-flushing read traps dropped

label: vsync-mailbox
desc: Check frame time with vsync Mailbox instead of Fifo

label: res-075
desc: Check frame time at 0.75x internal resolution instead of 1x

label: cpu-safe-math
desc: Check frame time with every unsafe CPU JIT shortcut off (cpuopt_unsafe_*)
